slides.heading: O1 — User list
slides.note: Each staff member must operate with individual credentials for accountability.
steps: Open Settings and select User tab.
Tap User list to see all employees.
Add staff: username, full name, role, and branch access.
Set user status to Active.
Save and share login details only with that staff person.

slides.heading: O2 — Roles
slides.note: Role definitions govern system safety and prevent unauthorized operations.
steps: Open Roles screen from User tab.
Review standard system roles (Admin, Cashier, Food Server, Kitchen, Rider).
Create custom operational roles only if specifically needed.
Maintain separation between cashier and manager authorities.
Never assign Admin role to all staff.

slides.heading: O3 — Role Privilege
slides.note: Privilege changes become active on the user's next login session.
steps: Open Role Privilege from User tab.
Select target role from dropdown or list.
Tick only permissions essential for that job (Settle, Stock, Masters, Back Office).
Save changes.
Staff must sign out and sign in again so permissions refresh.

slides.heading: O4 — PIN / Login
slides.note: Immediate account deactivation is a mandatory ISO 27001 compliance rule.
steps: Select user from User list.
Open PIN / Login credentials section.
Set or reset staff 4-digit quick-login PIN or password.
Instruct staff to keep their PIN strictly confidential.
When staff leaves employment, disable their user account the same day.
